## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed its scheduled activity during April 2025. The clinic recorded 209 captures during the month. Session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. No other operational issues were identified in the information provided for this report.

The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Capture levels are reported as submitted by the site, with the associated image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 209 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.9 per cent. The ungradable images were excluded from grading outcomes. The reported rate indicates the proportion of captures that could not be assessed from the available images.

## Grading

A total of 49 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This is the median interval reported for grading activity during April 2025. Together, the referable total and median lag provide the monthly summary of grading outcomes for East City Eye Clinic.
